204.canonical: Prefer anonymous or semi-anonymous immediate response over a show of hands — students do not want to answer against the person next to them — and use interspersed response questions or devices that record answers instantly, so even a large lecture can see the distribution in real time and be reprogrammed on the spot.

208.canonical: Plan instruction deliberately at nested levels — lesson inside topic inside course or curriculum — rather than leaving it to moment-to-moment improvisation: the purpose of planning is predictable results and intelligent improvisation rests on a good blueprint, so reject the belief that good teaching comes through artful spontaneity.
